relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: levels of such molecules as calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) and, to a lesser extent, the pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating peptide are elevated during migraine attacks

relationships.subject: gepants
relationships.evidence_quote: The clinical development of gepants, which are CGRP antagonists, for the acute treatment of migraine attacks

key_findings: CGRP elevated in CSF and serum during migraine; CGRP-targeted gepants and mAbs show promising results
